snippet.title: Hero Strike Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Hero Strike | Official Gameplay Trailer

Draft your army. Choose your hero. Shatter their citadel.

Hero Strike is a free-to-play 3v3 auto battler with 75+ units, 12 heroes, 200+ abilities, 170+ upgrades and 250 talents.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5415160
Discord: https://discord.gg/WCm77jFuMQ
Website: https://herostrikeonline.com

#HeroStrike #AutoBattler #Strategy
